name: incomplete-assessment
why: Two questions left unanswered and everything else Yes. The running total reads 100% because an unanswered question is in neither the numerator nor the denominator — which is correct for the score the assessor watches mid-visit, and catastrophic if it reaches a certificate. This case exists to pin the thing that stops it: the two questions are reported missing and is_complete is false, and the submission endpoint refuses on that rather than on the percentage looking implausible.
